{{Quote|A neutron detonator can wipe out a city, Private. If there's plans for one in there, I want all available manpower for this objective.|Lieutenant [[Piloc]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''neutron detonator''' was a type of [[City/Legends|city]]-busting explosive. The [[Bugtown|Farnel Research Facility]] was developing a neutron detonator before the [[Great Galactic War]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]]'s unit attempted to retrieve plans for the detonator during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
